ruleBatchAllowRejected: {count} 条放行规则（含 #@#）未导入：该规则为放行规则，请在白名单中添加。
{count} allow rules (with #@#) were not imported: allow rules belong in the allow list.
ruleDeletePresetMessage: 「{pattern}」是内置预设规则，删除后可通过重置默认恢复。
"{pattern}" is a built-in preset rule; resetting the defaults restores it.
ruleDeleteSubscriptionMessage: 「{pattern}」来自订阅「{name}」，删除后下次更新订阅可能重新出现。
"{pattern}" comes from the subscription "{name}" and may return on the next update.
ruleDeleteUserMessage: 确定删除「{pattern}」吗？此操作不可撤销。
ruleClearCustomMessage: 将删除全部用户自定义的{kind}规则，订阅与预设规则不受影响。
All user-defined {kind} rules will be deleted; subscription and preset rules are untouched.
ruleResetMessage: 将内置预设规则恢复为初始内容，你自己添加与订阅带来的规则保留。
Restores the built-in preset rules; rules you added and subscription rules are kept.
rulePresetProtectedMessage: 默认白名单规则处于只读状态。请先开启页面顶部的「允许编辑默认白名单」开关，再修改或删除这些规则。
Default allow list rules are read-only. Turn on "Allow editing the default allow list" at the top of the page before changing or deleting them.
ruleAllowEditMessage: 白名单是放行名单，改动它可能让本应被拦截的流量通过。确认你清楚这条风险后再开启。
The allow list lets traffic through, so changing it may pass traffic that should be blocked. Enable this only if you understand the risk.
